mapper.sql: SELECT d.od_detail_no AS OD_DETAIL_NO, d.od_option_name AS OD_OPTION_NAME, d.od_product_name AS OD_PRODUCT_NAME, d.od_price AS OD_PRICE, d.od_quantity AS OD_QUANTITY, d.od_amount AS OD_AMOUNT, d.od_at AS OD_AT, d.or_no AS OR_NO, d.p_no AS P_NO, d.o_no AS O_NO, opt.o_main_img AS P_MAIN_IMG, ord.or_status AS OR_STATUS FROM dc_order_detail d LEFT JOIN dc_product_option opt ON d.o_no = opt.o_no JOIN dc_order ord ON d.or_no = ord.or_no
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dc_order_detail (od_option_name, od_product_name, od_price, od_quantity, od_amount, od_at, or_no, p_no, o_no) VALUES (#{odOptionName}, #{odProductName}, #{odPrice}, #{odQuantity}, #{odAmount}, SYSDATE, #{orNo}, #{pNo}, #{oNo})

INSERT ALL INTO dc_order_detail (od_option_name, od_product_name, od_price, od_quantity, od_amount, od_at, or_no, p_no, o_no) VALUES (#{item.odOptionName}, #{item.odProductName}, #{item.odPrice}, #{item.odQuantity}, #{item.odAmount}, SYSDATE, #{item.orNo}, #{item.pNo}, #{item.oNo}) SELECT 1 FROM DUAL
mapper.update: UPDATE dc_order_detail SET od_quantity = #{odQuantity}, od_amount = #{odAmount} WHERE od_detail_no = #{odDetailNo}
